clause: Placeholder filler + external text import touchpoint [STU-TYP-007]

scope.summary: Support inserting placeholder filler text into a story (Paste Lorem Ipsum) and placing external text (TXT/RTF/DOC/DOCX) into area stories with encoding, style-map/preserve, and cleanup options. Full import-profile detail is governed by 14.13; 14.7 wires only the text-ingest touchpoint into StudioTextStory. Model command exposes placeholder-insert; import invokes the 14.13 pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: placeholder filler + TXT/RTF/DOC/DOCX ingest into area story; touchpoint to 14.13; encoding/style-map/cleanup options
expected_tests: live: placeholder filler inserted into story; TXT/RTF/DOCX placed into area story with encoding + style-map/preserve + cleanup options

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No filler/import ingest; content workflows blocked.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
